skills_considered.reason: The discovery ledger is a research surface owned by other batches; the one ledger correction this reading supports is proposed through the intake note rather than edited.
A patient genotype-phenotype report supplies no therapeutic lever for the reference genotype class; forging hypotheses from one case would manufacture a lead.
No compound is tested as an intervention with a measured outcome beyond clinical anecdote, so there is no molecule to send to BLOCK-1 triage.
Scientists do not touch the four current files; every change is proposed as a commit candidate for a later BATCH_COMMIT.
The triples are published in the candidates for a blind auditor; the reader of a paper cannot audit their own locators.

group_assessment.weighting: PubMed counts 2026-10-02: Li B[au] AND Hebei AND epilepsy 15; with WWOX 1 (this paper). A paediatric neurology group with a commercial minigene service; the clinical observation is credible, the functional claim is limited to a heterologous minigene and the drug-response conclusion rests on one child followed to 13 months.

field_density.note: One of two WWOX minigene records in PubMed; no WWOX splice allele has been measured in patient RNA with NMD inhibition.

multihop.note: 24 references enumerated. The prior report of the same allele (He 2020, compound heterozygous) is the only reference bearing on this allele; it was not read here and no claim depends on it. Not queued from this reading.

entries.proposition: The splicing assay is a minigene transfected into HEK293T cells, not patient RNA.
entries.snippet: transiently transfected into human embryonic kidney 293T cells (HEK293T)

experimental_context.genotype: WWOX exon1-3 minigene, WT vs c.172+1G>C

entries.proposition: The measured consequence is exon 2 skipping in the minigene.
entries.snippet: caused a splicing abnormality, which abrogated the intron 2 canonical splice site and led to a loss of exon 2

entries.proposition: Protein truncation is an in silico translation of the sequenced transcript, not a protein measurement.
entries.snippet: Finally, Snapgene software was used to translate nucleotide sequences into protein sequences

entries.proposition: The gel shows one product per lane: WT 426 bp and mutant 361 bp; the 65 bp difference equals exon 2 (NM_016373.4, 65 nt, out-of-frame). No residual full-length product is visible in the mutant lane at the published resolution; nothing is quantified.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation — pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 8b: two lanes labelled WT:426bp and MT:361bp, a single band in each; Figure 8c(ii) chromatogram labelled Exon1 | Exon3 junction (Exon2del); Figure 8a construct shows exon1-intron1-exon2-intron2-exon3.

entries.proposition: Homozygosity is attributed to uniparental disomy inferred from copy-neutral loss of heterozygosity on chromosome 16; no marker-based UPD test is reported.
Electrographic seizures persisted under vigabatrin at 11 months although not noticed at home.
entries.snippet: VEEG showed clinical seizures, but these were not noticed at home by her parents

entries.proposition: The seizure-freedom statement is clinical (no visible seizures) at 13 months, the last follow-up.
entries.snippet: when the child was 13 months old, she had no visible seizures
suggesting that vigabatrin may be an effective management option

entries.proposition: The paper cites Riva et al. with reference number 20, but its reference list has no Riva entry (reference 20 is Shaukat 2018).
entries.snippet: Riva et al. (20) reported that WWOX gene variation caused DEE in children

entries.proposition: EEG at 8 months shows spasm and tonic/myoclonic attacks; EEG labelled 5 months shows posterior slow activity; Figure 4, which the text dates to 11 months, is captioned 8 months.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation — pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figures 2-4: three multichannel VEEG screen captures with time-locked video insets (Figure 4) and EMG channels; Figure 4 caption reads 'at 8 months old'.

entries.proposition: Ancillary studies: atrial septal defect on echo, delayed right BAEP, reduced peroneal motor/sensory conduction on EMG.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation — pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 5 colour Doppler echo; Figure 6 ABR table with right-ear wave V latency longer than left; Figure 7 peroneal MCS and SCS tables.
